note: Plan prices for the website (index.html pricing) and checkout (pay.html). Change them here, then run python pulsedge-bot/offers.py qr && python pulsedge-bot/offers.py check. 'list' is the regular price from the day after launch_until (the end of the current offer): only show it while you mean to charge it then.

business.note: Annual business packages on business.html (one invoice a year, bank transfer or UPI). offers.py check confirms business.html shows these prices.

partner.note: Partner programme (sell.html): one fixed bonus per new customer, paid once on their first payment; renewals, upgrades and later payments earn nothing. offers.py check confirms sell.html shows these amounts.
